title: nf-zeta-coefficients
objective: Implement exact Dedekind-zeta coefficients, compact splitting streams, direct series, and controlled Euler products.

handoff.summary: Implemented strict ordinary-Python exact local Dedekind-zeta factors, authenticated compact splitting streams, Sage-indexed multiplicative coefficient sieves and blocks, and controlled direct-series/Euler-product midpoint evaluators for Re(s)>1. Focused tests cover quadratic convolution, a Sage/PARI cubic oracle, malformed streams, resource/domain guards, and honest proof diagnostics.
risks: The proved analytic-tail formulas are displayed through non-outward-rounded mpmath midpoints; rigorous=True intentionally rejects until integration combines them with Arb rounding balls.
The coefficient sieve uses O(bound) storage under explicit deterministic limits; coefficient blocks bound transport size but do not make the sieve sublinear-memory.
next_steps: Integration should bind the prime-ideal lane's splitting_records(order,start,stop) through a field/order closure.

Integration should expose coefficients, euler_factor(s), dirichlet_series, and euler_product on the shared DedekindZetaFunction and run the generated Sage.js half of the focused test after the root build stabilizes.
